items.headline: DJ Scott, Ray James Jr. rally North Dakota State to 21-13 victory over Hawaii
items.description: — DJ Scott capped a 16-play, fourth-quarter drive with a touchdown run, and Ray James Jr. returned an interception 49 yards for a score as North Dakota State rallied to beat Hawaii 21-13 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Alejado-Lacaden combo helps send Hawaii past UTEP 17-14
items.description: — Micah Alejado threw for 303 yards and a touchdown and Titan Lacaden had a career-high 109 yards receiving and a touchdown and Hawaii beat UTEP 17-14 on Saturday.
